entries.zh: 羞辱，使人丢脸（字作「舍」，取弃去、剥除之义）
entries.en: To dishonor, to put someone to shame (lit. 'to cast off'; Hokkien sià)
entries.notes: 「舍」字面为弃去，用以对 deshonrar 属闽南语引申用法，据后条「舍面皮」「舍人面皮」定；M 栏尾部残。

entries.en: To dishonor with words; to revile, to insult verbally
entries.notes: H 栏「尿/屎」字形存疑、M 作 xioŋ（T99），四栏仅于音上相合，义据 L「de palabra」定为言语辱骂。

entries.zh: 辱及门第；以「不長進」（没出息、不长进）骂人，使家门蒙羞
entries.en: To disgrace a man's lineage; to call him a good-for-nothing ('one who does not advance')
entries.notes: H 栏「長/掌」存疑，R 首音节 pîn 与「不」不合，语义据整条「不長進」定。

entries.zh: 使人丢脸，剥人脸面（舍人面皮）
entries.en: To make someone lose face; to strip a person of face
entries.notes: R 栏末字「pg」为「皮」之讹写，M 栏「siâ xīn bī̃ puē̃」可互证。

entries.zh: 辱骂父母（「父头母骨」为咒詈之辞，兼指父母）
entries.en: To dishonor one's father; to curse a man's parents ('father's head, mother's bones')
To humiliate to someone's face; to make a person lose face
entries.notes: L 栏「dar de [残] enel rostro」缺动词，是否指掴面存疑；释义据「舍面皮」及 enel rostro 定。

entries.en: Open country outside the city; the wilds (郊野)
entries.notes: R 栏「guiòia」音值与「郊野」不合，疑为讹写；义据 H「郊」及 M「caú ià」定。

entries.en: Wild, uncultivated country; the open wilds
Remote, out-of-the-way; a desolate place no one reaches
A remote spot; an out-of-the-way place
A wild place; a spot out in the wilds
Beyond the frontier; a remote, desolate region

entries.zh: 长短不齐，参差不等；长度
entries.en: Unequal, long and short; of uneven length

entries.zh: 大小不齐，块片大小不等
entries.en: Unequal in its parts; pieces of uneven size
entries.notes: M 栏末「lit tēy」未详，疑为「一塊」之音写；释义据「大細片」及 L「de partes desiguales」定。

entries.en: Partial, favoring one over another; unequal in heart
entries.notes: L 栏尾部「usar aco[残]」不完整，义据前半「Desigual enel animo」及「大細心」定。
